creator: Chris Huber Reitz
name: University of California, Berkeley
quote: High-Risk Use Cases: Use of AI that involves highly consequential automated decision-making requires extreme caution. These use cases are characterized by their potential to significantly impact individuals’ legal rights, academic standing, employment status, or well-being. Decisions of high consequence should generally be proposed, evaluated, and implemented by a human.
quote_label: Appropriate Use of Generative and Agentic AI (UC Berkeley AI Hub guidance), section 5 High-Risk or New Use Cases; page states 'Last updated: November 5, 2026'

provenance.note: Re-coded 2026-11-08 after a RESCOPE: the page now covers agentic AI and adds prohibited and high-risk uses. D2=2: 'You are responsible for any activities conducted by AI tools on your behalf' and an agentic tool 'cannot be an accountable party' under PPSM-20. D5=2: 'human-in-the-loop verification' for financial actions, 'direct human review' before agents communicate for the University, consequential decisions 'implemented by a human'. D3=0: no disclosure or labeling duty survives in the new text. D4=1: agents may not give the impression of representing the University; no fabrication rule. D1=1: units deploying agents 'should maintain logs of actions taken by AI agents' (should, not must). D6=1: 'Always examine the AI's activities and output'. c3 moves Evidential to Both-split: the reserve line is argued from accountability locus (who can be an accountable party under PPSM-20, BFB-BUS-43, IS-3) as much as from data protection. c2 stays partially: reserved domains mix proof-scarce judgment (grading, hiring, discipline) with proof-cheap transactions (purchases, credential grants); the line is drawn by consequence and delegated authority, not verification cost. Twilight true: 'a living document ... updated frequently'. The page still says it 'is not itself a campus policy' but interprets UC policy. Prior note (2026-08-23) flagged that the earlier page scored lower on re-read; that concern is moot after the rescope.
